links.outcome: Reading grade level of chatbot patient education responses versus recommended sixth-grade level
links.effect: Mean grade levels 11th-13th across tools; mean FRES 40.2; ChatGPT 14.8, Copilot 12.3, Gemini 13.1, Meta AI 9.6 mean grade level; all exceed sixth-grade recommendation.
links.quote: This means that the materials were at the high school and even college reading level, which far exceeds the recommended sixth-grade level for patient education materials.

links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated patient education materials on cardiac catheterization
links.effect: Mean FRES 40.2 across chatbots (31, 35.8, 36.4, 57.7); grade levels 11.2-13.7 across six indices, above plain-language level.
links.quote: The mean FRES across all four chatbots was 40.2, while overall mean grade levels for the four chatbots were 11.2, 13.7, 13.7, 13.3, 11.2, and 11.6 across the FKGL, GFI, CLI, SMOG, ARI, and FORCAST indices, respectively.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the readability of patient education materials generated by four LLM chatbots using standardized readability formulas without testing a specific organizational deployment safeguard or constraint.
